surface: Member Settings native acceptance identity gate
auth_mode: member infrastructure; no product behavior credited
title: Settings acceptance confuses a load-ladder organization with a persisted device choice
severity: S2: the member native test stops before preference cases even when the selected organization is valid
priority: P1: repair the identity oracle before interpreting a member Settings native run
preconditions: Use the receipt-bound member Settings native artifact and private member fixture; the extension may resolve its active organization from the account load ladder without writing matrx.org.active.
reproduction: Run the member Settings native acceptance at CI development source 8d2f8ca2 using the guarded hosted path (run 38051093370).
After successful member sign-in, observe the selected Organization label and absent device-choice key at baseline/settings_ready.
Observe d87_rendered_identity_not_observed before any persistence case because the runner expects the fixture's logical organization UUID in device-choice storage.
expected: The oracle distinguishes a validated load-ladder organization from an explicit device choice, proves the live request-bound organization ID equals the private fixture ID, and then evaluates the member Settings persistence cases.
actual: Sanitized run 38051093370 reports stored_device_choice_absent=true, rendered_organization_selected=true, expected_device_choice_absent=false, identity_ready=false, and zero persistence cases. The first candidate corrected post-sign-in checks but omitted resolution in the immediate check and could accept a correct label with the wrong live organization ID; independent review rejected it.
cause: The harness reused the logical load-ladder organization UUID as the expected matrx.org.active device-choice UUID. The original and first repair also lacked an independent read-only proof of the actual request-bound organization UUID.
sibling_census: The member Scrape Save harness also uses the selected organization as a write target; its own pre-save read-only request-bound proof is being added under this infrastructure repair. No product storage defect is established.
